verdict.rationale: Workers supports many frameworks (Next, Astro, Vue, etc.), a CLI (Wrangler) for CI/deploy, and a local dev simulator, letting devs keep familiar editors and frameworks. However, using Workers' storage/compute (KV, D1, Durable Objects) requires proprietary bindings and the Wrangler toolchain, and community feedback notes lock-in and lack of a full Node runtime block seamless migration of existing stacks.
